# REDTEAM #58 (SPEC Sec 2.3, T-203.4/T-105; IMPLEMENTATION.md M13-S3):
# duplicate specialized clones colliding across packages. Each clone MUST
# carry a unique package-local name, and no name-based dedup pass MUST pick
# among clones (at Os/Oz the linker MAY fold content-identical functions).
# Two packages specialize the same imported clone-eligible pattern at -O=3;
# package-local clone names keep the link collision-free, and both packages
# print correct results. A global-name clone scheme fails the link with a
# duplicate symbol instead of passing silently. The O1 run (no
# specialization) must agree with O3.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos run -O=3 .
stdout '^p1: 8 hello-p1$'
stdout '^p2: 8 hello-p2$'

logos run -O=1 .
stdout '^p1: 8 hello-p1$'
stdout '^p2: 8 hello-p2$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam58

go 1.27

-- imp/imp.go --
package imp

import "io"

// Copy is clone-eligible at -O=3: both parameters serve only as method
// receivers, so each concrete call site gets a clone with retyped
// parameters.
func Copy(w io.Writer, r io.Reader) (int64, error) {
	buf := make([]byte, 4)
	var n int64
	for {
		k, err := r.Read(buf)
		if k > 0 {
			m, werr := w.Write(buf[:k])
			n += int64(m)
			if werr != nil {
				return n, werr
			}
		}
		if err == io.EOF {
			return n, nil
		}
		if err != nil {
			return n, err
		}
	}
}

-- p1/p1.go --
package p1

import (
	"bytes"

	"example.com/redteam58/imp"
)

// Run specializes imp.Copy over (*bytes.Buffer, *bytes.Reader) from this
// package; p2 specializes the identical pattern from its own package.
func Run() (int64, string) {
	var b bytes.Buffer
	n, err := imp.Copy(&b, bytes.NewReader([]byte("hello-p1")))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return n, b.String()
}

-- p2/p2.go --
package p2

import (
	"bytes"

	"example.com/redteam58/imp"
)

// Run specializes imp.Copy over (*bytes.Buffer, *bytes.Reader) from this
// package; p1 specializes the identical pattern from its own package.
func Run() (int64, string) {
	var b bytes.Buffer
	n, err := imp.Copy(&b, bytes.NewReader([]byte("hello-p2")))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return n, b.String()
}

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/redteam58/p1"
	"example.com/redteam58/p2"
)

func main() {
	n1, s1 := p1.Run()
	n2, s2 := p2.Run()
	fmt.Println("p1:", n1, s1)
	fmt.Println("p2:", n2, s2)
	if s1 != "hello-p1" || s2 != "hello-p2" || n1 != 8 || n2 != 8 {
		panic("redteam58: cross-package clones diverged")
	}
}
